title: Invoice fields read right
method: Values accepted without review, on invoice layouts held out of development (report 23).

title: Payments matched automatically
method: 868 of 984 payment lines posted with no person, 0 wrong (report 27).

title: Valid claims wrongly disputed
method: Same claims across 8 held-out simulated ledgers; each count is a valid claim disputed in error (report 37).

title: Deduction reasons understood
method: Reason wordings held out of development, fixed before scoring (report 36).

title: Incorrect postings under a silent fault
method: A silent 5% fault on 7,019 lines across 8 held-out simulated ledgers, 200 replays (report 40).

title: Input changes caught
method: Five injected input changes across 8 held-out simulated ledgers; false alarms on cash and claims: 0 (report 47).

title: Demand forecast error
method: 30,490 Walmart M5 series, final 8 weeks, scored once after the model was frozen.

title: Weeks inside the 80% range
method: Ranges calibrated on earlier weeks only; a well-calibrated 80% range should contain about 80%.

title: Promotion lift prediction
method: 167 held-out price cuts, scored once. The model did not beat the no-lift baseline, so it is not used for recommendations.

title: Lost-sales value detected
method: 11,027 test stock-outs inserted into the final 8 M5 weeks, scored once. Weekly data cannot detect stock-outs of slow sellers.
